✅ Alloy updateVariable actions — eVars, props, and events set via data.__adobe.analytics are fully extracted including which data element feeds each variable.
✅ XDM Object data elements — eVars and props mapped under _experience.analytics.customDimensions are extracted. XDM objects appear both as the DE source in the chain view AND as browseable entries in the XDM Objects section — click any XDM Object to see its field mappings and which rules use it.
✅ Classic AA Set Variables actions — eVars and props set via trackerProperties.eVars[] are fully extracted with DE source links.
⚠️ Custom code actions — the variable name is detected but the data element source cannot be read. These show as "Custom code — value set at runtime".
⚠️ Product list item variables — eVars nested inside productListItems[] arrays are partially extracted via recursive traversal but may not appear for all product schemas.
❌ Alloy Variable data elements — DEs of type variable/index.js store values at runtime via a dataElementId reference. Their contents cannot be read from the deployed container and will not appear here.
❌ Variables set via adobeDataLayer.push() — values pushed to the data layer and consumed by listener rules are resolved at runtime only and cannot be statically mapped.
ℹ️ This map is site-wide — it shows all variables configured across all rules in the deployed container, not filtered by the current page or whether a rule fired during this visit.
